content.title: THE QUIET NUTRIENT {{CHAMPIONS}} IN YOUR PRODUCE AISLE
facts: **Guava** packs roughly **four times more vitamin C** than an **orange**, making it one of the most overlooked immune-boosting fruits at the store.
Ounce for ounce, **dried figs** contain **more calcium** than a glass of **milk**, quietly supporting bone health without a dairy label.
**Chia seeds** carry nearly **twice the omega-3 ALA** found in **walnuts**, despite walnuts getting all the credit for plant-based omega-3s.
A cup of **raspberries** has about **two and a half times more fiber** than a **banana**, keeping digestion steady with far less sugar.
**Swiss chard** delivers roughly **eight times more vitamin K** than **broccoli**, making it a surprisingly powerful leafy green for blood and bone health.
